G4863.strongs: to lead together, i.e. collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably)
G4863.kjv: + accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in
senses: συν-άγω to gather or bring together: of things, [[r:JHN.6.12|Jhn 6:12-13]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.3.12|Mat 3:12]], al.; ἐκεῖ, [[r:LUK.12.18|Luk 12:18]]; ποῦ, [[r:LUK.12.17|Luk 12:17]]; συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, Notes, 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all: [[r:LUK.15.13|Luk 15:13]]; of persons, [[r:JHN.11.52|Jhn 11:52]]; esp. of assemblies, [[r:MAT.2.4|Mat 2:4]], [[r:JHN.11.47|Jhn 11:47]], [[r:ACT.14.27|Act 14:27]], al. Pass., to be gathered or come together: [[r:MAT.22.41|Mat 22:41]], [[r:MRK.2.2|Mrk 2:2]], [[r:LUK.22.66|Luk 22:66]], al.; before ἐπί [[r:MRK.5.21|Mrk 5:21]], [[r:ACT.4.27|Act 4:27]]; πρός, [[r:MAT.13.2|Mat 13:2]], [[r:MRK.4.1|Mrk 4:1]], al.; εἰς, [[r:REV.19.17|Rev 19:17]]; ἐν, [[r:ACT.11.26|Act 11:26]]; μετά, [[r:MAT.28.12|Mat 28:12]]; οὗ, [[r:MAT.18.20|Mat 18:20]]; ὅπου, [[r:MAT.26.57|Mat 26:57]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:JHN.18.2|Jhn 18:2]], al. In late writers (see Kennedy, Sources, 128; cf. [[r:DEU.22.2|Deu 22:2]], al.), to receive hospitably, entertain: [[r:MAT.25.35|Mat 25:35, 38 25:43]] (cf. ἐπι-συνάγω) (AS)

G4864.strongs: an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church
senses: συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ prop., a bringing together;
of things,
a gathering in of harvest;
a collection of money.
Of persons,
a collecting, assembling (Polyb.);

an assembly (MM, xxiv; Deiss., LAE, 101 ff.): [[r:REV.2.9|Rev 2:9 3:9]]; esp. of a Jewish religious assembly, a synagogue: [[r:LUK.12.11|Luk 12:11]], [[r:ACT.9.2|Act 9:2]], al.; of a Christian assembly, [[r:JAS.2.2|Jas 2:2.]] By meton., of the building in which the assembly is held, a synagogue: [[r:MAT.10.17|Mat 10:17]], [[r:MRK.1.21|Mrk 1:21]], al. (cf. Cremer, see word ἐκκλησία) SYN.: ἐκκλησία (which see) (AS)

G4892.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of [[w:G4862]] and the base of [[w:G1476]]
G4892.strongs: a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal
senses: (σύν + ἕδρα, a seat)
a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, [[r:MAT.10.17|Mat 10:17]], [[r:MRK.13.9|Mrk 13:9]].

The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): [[r:MAT.5.22|Mat 5:22 26:59]], [[r:MRK.14.55|Mrk 14:55 15:1]], [[r:LUK.22.66|Luk 22:66]], [[r:ACT.5.21|Act 5:21, 27 5:34, 41 6:12, 15 22:30 23:1, 6 23:15, 20 23:28]] (WH, R, mg., om.) [[r:ACT.24.20|Act 24:20]] of a meeting of the Sanhedrin, [[r:JHN.11.47|Jhn 11:47]]; of the place of meeting, [[r:ACT.4.15|Act 4:15.]]† (AS)

G4851.strongs: to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
G4851.kjv: be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for)
senses: συμ-φέρω
trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.19.19|Act 19:19.]]

Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: [[r:1CO.6.12|1Co 6:12 10:23]], [[r:2CO.8.10|2Co 8:10]]; with inf. (M, Pr., 210), [[r:MAT.19.10|Mat 19:10]], [[r:JHN.18.14|Jhn 18:14]]; with dative, before ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), [[r:MAT.5.29|Mat 5:29-30 18:6]], [[r:JHN.11.50|Jhn 11:50 16:7]]. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: [[r:1CO.12.7|1Co 12:7]]; pl., [[r:ACT.20.20|Act 20:20]]; (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), [[r:2CO.12.1|2Co 12:1]]; as subst., τὸ σ., profit, [[r:HEB.12.10|Heb 12:10.]]† (AS)

G4816.root: from [[w:G4862]] and [[w:G3004]] in its original sense
senses: συλ-λέγω to bring together, collect, gather up: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.13.28|Mat 13:28-30]]; pass., [[r:MAT.13.40|Mat 13:40]]; with accusative, before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.7.16|Mat 7:16]]; id. before ἐκ, [[r:MAT.13.41|Mat 13:41]], [[r:LUK.6.44|Luk 6:44]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.13.48|Mat 13:48.]]† (AS)

G4873.strongs: to recline in company with (at a meal)
G4873.kjv: sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat)
senses: συν-ανά-κειμαι to recline with or together at table: [[r:MAT.14.9|Mat 14:9]], [[r:MRK.6.22|Mrk 6:22]], [[r:LUK.7.49|Luk 7:49 14:15]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.9.10|Mat 9:10]], [[r:MRK.2.15|Mrk 2:15]], [[r:LUK.14.10|Luk 14:10]].† (AS)

G4824.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G4825]]
G4824.strongs: advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e. the provincial assessors or lay-court
senses: (σύμβουλος), a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and see Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.),
counsel: σ. λαμβάνειν, [[r:MAT.12.14|Mat 12:14 22:15 27:7 28:12]]; διδόναι, [[r:MRK.3.6|Mrk 3:6]] (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, [[r:MRK.15.1|Mrk 15:1]] (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.).
By meton., a council (4Mac, l.with א; συνέδριον, AR): [[r:ACT.25.12|Act 25:12]] (see MM, xxiv).† (AS)

G4846.strongs: to strangle completely, i.e. (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd
senses: συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-), to choke: of thronging by a crowd, [[r:LUK.8.42|Luk 8:42.]] Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, [[r:MAT.13.22|Mat 13:22]], [[r:MRK.4.7|Mrk 4:7, 19]], [[r:LUK.8.14|Luk 8:14]].† (AS)
συν-αυξάνω to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: [[r:MAT.13.30|Mat 13:30]] (Xen., al.).† (AS)
to talk or converse with another, (New Testament) (ML)

G4856.strongs: to be harmonious, i.e. (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact)
senses: συμ-φωνέω, -ῶ, prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical,

to agree with, agree together: [[r:LUK.5.36|Luk 5:36]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.15.15|Act 15:15]]; before περί, [[r:MAT.18.19|Mat 18:19]]; pass., with dative of person(s), συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, [[r:ACT.5.9|Act 5:9]];
to agree as to a price (Polyb., Diod.): with dative of person(s), genitive pret., [[r:MAT.20.13|Mat 20:13]]; before μετά... ἐκ, [[r:MAT.20.2|Mat 20:2.]]† (AS)

G4868.strongs: to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account)
senses: συν-αίρω to take up together: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr., 160), to settle accounts, [[r:MAT.18.23|Mat 18:23-24]]; before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.25.19|Mat 25:19.]]† (AS)

G4889.strongs: a co-slave, i.e. servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine)
senses: σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ a fellow-servant: [[r:MAT.18.28|Mat 18:28-33 24:49]]; of servants of the same divine Lord, [[r:COL.1.7|Col 1:7 4:7]], [[r:REV.6.11|Rev 6:11]]; so of angels, [[r:REV.19.10|Rev 19:10 22:9]].† (AS)

G4801.strongs: to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage)
senses: συν-ζεύγνυμι (Rec. συζ-), to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, [[r:MAT.19.6|Mat 19:6]], [[r:MRK.10.9|Mrk 10:9]].† (AS)

G4862.strongs: with or together (but much closer than or), i.e. by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc.
senses: prep. with dative, expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. [[r:JAS.1.11|Jas 1:11]], [[r:2PE.1.18|2Pe 1:18]]) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, [[r:LUK.2.13|Luk 2:13]], [[r:JHN.21.3|Jhn 21:3]], [[r:ACT.10.23|Act 10:23]], al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, [[r:LUK.7.12|Luk 7:12]], [[r:ACT.4.13|Act 4:13]], [[r:PHP.1.23|Php 1:23]], al.; of partisanship, [[r:ACT.4.13|Act 4:13]]; οἱ σύν τινι, of attendants, companions or colleagues, [[r:MRK.2.26|Mrk 2:26]], [[r:LUK.5.9|Luk 5:9]], [[r:ACT.5.17|Act 5:17]], al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, [[r:1CO.15.10|1Co 15:10]]; of two or more things together, almost = καί, [[r:LUK.23.11|Luk 23:11]], [[r:ACT.3.4|Act 3:4 10:2 14:5 23:25]], [[r:EPH.3.18|Eph 3:18]]; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, [[r:2CO.13.4|2Co 13:4]]; besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, [[r:LUK.24.21|Luk 24:21.]] In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω) (AS)

G4823.strongs: to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e. recommend, deliberate or determine
senses: 1. to advise, counsel , Lat. consulere alicui, with dative pers. et infinitive, to advise one to do a thing, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. 2. without the infinitive, ς. τινί τι (Herdotus Historicus); ς. τι to recommend a measure, (Herdotus Historicus), attic:—;Pass., τὰ συμβουλευόμενα the advice given , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. absolute to advise, give advice , (Sophocles Tragicus); ὁ συμβουλεύων or -εύσας, an adviser , Lat. auctor sententiae, (Aristotle Philosopher) 4. Mid. to consult with a person, i. e. ask his advice , Lat. consulere aliquem, with dative, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: absolute to consult, deliberate , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4815.strongs: to clasp, i.e. seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid
senses: συλ-λαμβάνω
with accusative, to bring together, collect.

to seize, take: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, [[r:MAT.26.55|Mat 26:55]], [[r:MRK.14.48|Mrk 14:48]], [[r:LUK.22.54|Luk 22:54]], [[r:JHN.18.12|Jhn 18:12]], [[r:ACT.1.16|Act 1:16 12:3]]; pass., [[r:ACT.23.27|Act 23:27]]; mid., in sense of act., [[r:ACT.26.21|Act 26:21]]; σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, [[r:LUK.5.9|Luk 5:9.]]
C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: [[r:LUK.5.7|Luk 5:7]], [[r:PHP.4.3|Php 4:3]].

Of a woman, to conceive: absol., [[r:LUK.1.24|Luk 1:24]]; before ἐν γαστρί, [[r:LUK.1.31|Luk 1:31]]; with accusative, [[r:LUK.1.36|Luk 1:36]]; ib. before ἐν τ. κοιλίᾳ, [[r:LUK.2.21|Luk 2:21]]; metaphorically, of lust producing sin, [[r:JAS.1.15|Jas 1:15.]]† (AS)

G4802.strongs: to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil
senses: συν-ζητέω (Rec. συζ-), -ῶ,
to search or examine together (Plat.).

In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: [[r:MRK.1.27|Mrk 1:27 12:28]], [[r:LUK.24.15|Luk 24:15]]; before quæst. indir., [[r:MRK.9.10|Mrk 9:10]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.8.11|Mrk 8:11]] [[r:ACT.6.9|Act 6:9]]; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.9.14|Mrk 9:14, 16]], [[r:ACT.9.29|Act 9:29]]; id. before quæst. indir., [[r:LUK.22.23|Luk 22:23.]]† (AS)

G4818.strongs: to afflict jointly, i.e. (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone
senses: συν-λυπέω (Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: before ἐπί, with dative, [[r:MRK.3.5|Mrk 3:5.]]† (AS)

συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ to follow along with, accompany: with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.14.51|Mrk 14:51]], [[r:LUK.23.49|Luk 23:49]]; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[r:MRK.5.37|Mrk 5:37.]]† (AS)

G4849.root: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of [[w:G4844]]
G4849.strongs: a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests
senses: 1. a drinking-party, symposium , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc. 2. the room in which such parties were given, drinking-room , (Lucian) (ML)

G4848.strongs: to journey together; by implication, to assemble
senses: συν-πορεύομαι (Rec. σνμπ-),
to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.7.11|Luk 7:11 14:25 24:15]].
to come together: [[r:MRK.10.1|Mrk 10:1]] (Plut., al.).† (AS)

G4819.strongs: to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place)
senses: συμ-βαίνω
to stand with the feet together.
to come together, come to terms.

Of events, to come to pass, happen: with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.10.32|Mrk 10:32]], [[r:ACT.3.10|Act 3:10 20:19]], [[r:1CO.10.11|1Co 10:11]], [[r:1PE.4.12|1Pe 4:12]], [[r:2PE.2.22|2Pe 2:22]]; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, [[r:LUK.24.14|Luk 24:14]] (cf. [[r:1MA.4.26|1Ma 4:26]]); with accusative and nf., [[r:ACT.21.35|Act 21:35.]]† (AS)

G4880.strongs: to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to
senses: συν-απο-θνήσκω to die with or together: [[r:MRK.14.31|Mrk 14:31]], [[r:2CO.7.3|2Co 7:3]] (see Meyer, in l), [[r:2TI.2.11|2Ti 2:11.]]† (AS)
συν-ανα-βαίνω to go up with: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[r:MRK.15.41|Mrk 15:41]], [[r:ACT.13.31|Act 13:31]].† (AS)

G4820.strongs: to combine, i.e. (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack
G4820.kjv: confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder
senses: συν-βάλλω (Rec. συμ-), to throw together, hence,

of speech (before λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.11.53|Luk 11:53]], WH, mg., [[r:ACT.17.18|Act 17:18]]; before πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[r:ACT.4.15|Act 4:15]];

to reflect, consider, ponder: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[r:LUK.2.19|Luk 2:19]]; (with) to meet with, fall in with: [[r:ACT.20.14|Act 20:14]]; in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, with dative (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), [[r:LUK.14.31|Luk 14:31]];
mid., to contribute (Polyb., al.; cf. MM, xxiv): [[r:ACT.18.27|Act 18:27.]]† (AS)

G4826.strongs: Symeon (i.e. Shimon), the name of five Israelites
senses: Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[r:LUK.2.25|Luk 2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
the son of Jacob ([[r:GEN.29.33|Gen 29:33]]): [[r:REV.7.7|Rev 7:7]].
An ancestor of our Lord: [[r:LUK.3.30|Luk 3:30]]
An aged worshipper in the Temple: [[r:LUK.2.25|Luk 2:25, 34]].
One surnamed Niger: [[r:ACT.13.1|Act 13:1.]]
The apostle Peter: [[r:ACT.15.14|Act 15:14]], [[r:2PE.1.1|2Pe 1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)

G4811.root: from a compound of [[w:G4810]] and a derivative of [[w:G5316]]
G4811.strongs: to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from Greece), "sycophant", i.e. (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort)
G4811.kjv: accuse falsely, take by false accusation
senses: (σῦκον, φαίνω), to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): [[r:LUK.3.14|Luk 3:14]] (R, mg.) [[r:LUK.19.8|Luk 19:8]] (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, Essays, 89 ff., see also Field, Notes, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).† (AS)
σύν-ειμι (εἶμι, to go), to come together: [[r:LUK.8.4|Luk 8:4.]]† (AS)
συν-φύω (Rec. συμ-), to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): [[r:LUK.8.7|Luk 8:7.]]† (AS)

G4845.strongs: to implenish completely, i.e. (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete)
senses: συν-πληρόω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,
to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, [[r:LUK.8.23|Luk 8:23.]]
to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.with, and see MM, xxiv), [[r:LUK.9.51|Luk 9:51]], [[r:ACT.2.1|Act 2:1]] (on the "durative inf.," see M, Pr., 233).† (AS)
συν-αρπάζω "perfective " of ἁοπάζω (see M, Pr., 113),
to seize and carry away (so most commonly): [[r:ACT.27.15|Act 27:15]];
to seize and hold: [[r:LUK.8.29|Luk 8:29]], [[r:ACT.6.12|Act 6:12 19:29]].† (AS)

G4895.strongs: to be in company with, i.e. present at the time
senses: σύν-ειμι (εἰμί to be), to be with: [[r:LUK.9.18|Luk 9:18]] (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), [[r:ACT.22.11|Act 22:11.]]† (AS)

G4876.strongs: to meet with; figuratively, to occur
senses: συν-αντάω, -ῶ to meet with: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.9.18|Luk 9:18, 37 22:10]], [[r:ACT.10.25|Act 10:25]], [[r:HEB.7.1|Heb 7:1, 10]]. Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall (Ding. L., Plut., al.): [[r:ACT.20.22|Act 20:22.]]† (AS)

G4878.strongs: to take hold of opposite together, i.e. co-operate (assist)
senses: συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help (with various constructions, see LXX, ll. with, Deiss., LAE, 83 f.): with dative, [[r:LUK.10.40|Luk 10:40]], [[r:ROM.8.26|Rom 8:26]].† (AS)

G4858.strongs: unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e. a concert of instruments (harmonious note)
senses: (σύμφωνος),
symphony, music: [[r:LUK.15.25|Luk 15:25]]
a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).† (AS)

G4807.root: of Hebrew origin ([[w:H8256]]) in imitation of [[w:G4809]]
senses: the mulberry tree (Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, [[r:1MA.6.34|1Ma 6:34]] *), the sycamine: [[r:LUK.17.6|Luk 17:6.]] (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC, in l; DB, iv, 634.) † (AS)

συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., [[r:PSA.78.47|Psa 78:47]], [[r:ISA.9.10|Isa 9:10]]) συκόμορος (σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry), a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: [[r:LUK.19.4|Luk 19:4]] (cf. συκάμινος).† (AS)

G4817.strongs: to reckon together (with oneself), i.e. deliberate
senses: συλ-λογίζομαι
to compute.
to reason: [[r:LUK.20.5|Luk 20:5.]]† (AS)

G4836.strongs: to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid
senses: συν-παρα-γίνομαι (Rec. συμπ-),
to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, [[r:LUK.23.48|Luk 23:48.]]
to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; [[r:2TI.4.16|2Ti 4:16]], Rec.).† (AS)

συν-αθροίζω to gather together, assemble: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.19.25|Act 19:25]]; pass., [[r:ACT.12.12|Act 12:12.]]† ἀθροίζω (ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), to Gather, assemble: [[r:LUK.24.33|Luk 24:33.]]† (AS)

G4897.kjv: go in with, go with into
senses: συν-εισ-έρχομαι to enter together: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[r:JHN.6.22|Jhn 6:22 18:15]].† (AS)
συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ a fellow-disciple: [[r:JHN.11.16|Jhn 11:16]] (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).† (AS)
συν-αλίζω to assemble with: [[r:ACT.1.4|Act 1:4]] (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, Notes, 110).† (AS)

G4894.strongs: to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of
G4894.kjv: consider, know, be privy, be ware of
senses: συν-εῖδον irreg. aorist of συνοράω (see: εἶδον),
to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.).
to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.): [[r:ACT.12.12|Act 12:12 14:6]] (on the related σύνοιδα, see see word).† (AS)

G4886.strongs: a joint tie, i.e. ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control
senses: σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ (συνδέω), that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, [[r:COL.2.19|Col 2:19.]] Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, [[r:ACT.8.23|Act 8:23]]; τ. τελειότητος, [[r:COL.3.14|Col 3:14]]; τ. εἰρήνης, [[r:EPH.4.3|Eph 4:3]] (see Lft., Col., ll. with).† (AS)

G4822.strongs: causative (by reduplication) of the base of); to drive together, i.e. unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach
G4822.kjv: compact, assuredly gather, intrust, knit together, prove
senses: συν-βιβάζω (Rec. συμ-),
to join or knit together, unite: [[r:EPH.4.16|Eph 4:16]], [[r:COL.2.2|Col 2:2]] (but see infr.), [[r:COL.2.19|Col 2:19.]]
to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): [[r:ACT.16.10|Act 16:10.]]
to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): [[r:ACT.9.22|Act 9:22.]]

As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaphorically), to teach, instruct: [[r:1CO.2.16|1Co 2:16]] [[r:ACT.19.33|Act 19:33]], R, mg. (also in Vg., [[r:COL.2.2|Col 2:2]], instructi, but see supr.).† (AS)

G4844.strongs: to partake a beverage in company
senses: συμπόσιον, -ου, τό (συμπίνω),
a drinking party
By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: [[r:MRK.6.39|Mrk 6:39.]]† (AS)
συν-παρα-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), to take along with: as a companion, with accusative, [[r:ACT.12.25|Act 12:25 15:37-38]] (on the tenses, see M, Pr., 130), [[r:GAL.2.1|Gal 2:1.]]† (AS)
συμ-ψηφίζω to reckon together, count up: [[r:ACT.19.19|Act 19:19.]]† (AS)

G4898.strongs: a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller
senses: συν-έκδημος, -ου, ὁ (ἔκδημος, abroad), a fellow-traveller: [[r:ACT.19.29|Act 19:29]], [[r:2CO.8.1|2Co 8:1]].† (AS)

G4843.root: from [[w:G4862]] and a compound of [[w:G4012]] and [[w:G2983]]
G4843.strongs: to take by enclosing altogether, i.e. earnestly throw the arms about one
senses: συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-),
to enclose ([[r:EZK.5.3|Eze 5:3]] (צוּר) *).
to embrace: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.20.10|Act 20:10.]]† (AS)
(συντρέχω), concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: [[r:ACT.21.30|Act 21:30]] (Arist., Polyb., al.).† (AS)
συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ (συνεῖδον),
consciousness: with genitive obj., [[r:HEB.10.2|Heb 10:2]], [[r:1PE.2.19|1Pe 2:19]].

In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): [[r:ROM.2.15|Rom 2:15 9:1]], [[r:1CO.10.29|1Co 10:29]], [[r:2CO.1.12|2Co 1:12 4:2 5:11]], [[r:1TI.4.2|1Ti 4:2]], [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]]; σ. ἀγαθή, [[r:ACT.23.1|Act 23:1]], [[r:1TI.1.5|1Ti 1:5 1:19]], [[r:1PE.3.16|1Pe 3:16 3:21]]; ἀσθενής, [[r:1CO.8.7|1Co 8:7 8:10]]; ἀσθενοῦσα, [[r:1CO.8.12|1Co 8:12]]; ἀπρόσκοπος, [[r:ACT.24.16|Act 24:16]]; καθαρά, [[r:1TI.3.9|1Ti 3:9]], [[r:2TI.1.3|2Ti 1:3]]; καλή, [[r:HEB.13.18|Heb 13:18]]; πονηρά, [[r:HEB.10.22|Heb 10:22]]; ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ σ., [[r:TIT.1.15|Tit 1:15]]; διὰ τὴν σ., [[r:ROM.13.5|Rom 13:5]], [[r:1CO.10.25|1Co 10:25 10:27-28]]; κατὰ σ., [[r:HEB.9.9|Heb 9:9]]; ὑπὸ (τῆς) σ., [[r:JHN.8.1|Jhn 8:1-59]] (Rec.), [[r:1CO.10.29|1Co 10:29]] (cf. Cremer, 233 ff.; ICC on [[r:ROM.2.15|Rom 2:15]]; DB, i, 468 ff.).† (AS)

G4840.strongs: to be at hand together, i.e. now present
senses: συν-πάρειμι (Rec. σνμπ-), to be present together or with: with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.25.24|Act 25:24.]]† (AS)
συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: [[r:ROM.1.12|Rom 1:12.]]† (AS)

G4828.strongs: to testify jointly, i.e. corroborate by (concurrent) evidence
senses: συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ, to bear witness with: [[r:ROM.2.15|Rom 2:15]]; with dative, [[r:ROM.8.16|Rom 8:16]]; before ὅτι, [[r:ROM.9.1|Rom 9:1.]]† (AS)

G4854.strongs: grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to
senses: σύμ-φυτος, -ον (συμφύω, to make to grow together)
congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with).
grown along with, united with: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, Notes, 155 f.), [[r:ROM.6.5|Rom 6:5.]]† (AS)

G4800.strongs: to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively)
senses: συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-), to live with: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, [[r:2CO.7.3|2Co 7:3]]; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, [[r:ROM.6.8|Rom 6:8]], [[r:2TI.2.11|2Ti 2:11]].† (AS)

G4852.strongs: to say jointly, i.e. assent to
senses: σύν φημι (Rec. συμ-), to consent, confess: with dative, before ὅτι, [[r:ROM.7.16|Rom 7:16.]]† (AS)

G4841.strongs: to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize")
senses: συν-πάσχω (Rec. συμπ-),
to suffer together or with: [[r:ROM.8.17|Rom 8:17]], [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28]].
to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).† (AS)

G4888.strongs: to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with
senses: συν-δοξάζω
to join in approving (Arist.).
In NT only, to glorify together: pass., [[r:ROM.8.17|Rom 8:17.]]† (AS)
σύμ-μορφος, -ον (σύν, μορφή),
absol., similar (Luc.).
con­formed to: with dative, [[r:PHP.3.21|Php 3:21]]; with genitive, [[r:ROM.8.29|Rom 8:29]] (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).† (AS)
(σύν, βουλή), a counsellor, adviser: [[r:ROM.11.34|Rom 11:34]] (LXX).† (AS)

G4879.strongs: to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield)
senses: συν-απ-άγω to lead away with or together (Ex, l.with). Pass., metaphorically (as συμπεριφέρομαι, see LS, see word), to be carried away with: with dative, [[r:GAL.2.13|Gal 2:13]], [[r:2PE.3.17|2Pe 3:17]]; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163), [[r:ROM.12.16|Rom 12:16.]]† (AS)

G4865.strongs: to struggle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant)
senses: συν-αγωνίζομαι to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), [[r:ROM.15.30|Rom 15:30.]]† (AS)

G4875.strongs: to recruit oneself in company with
senses: συν-ανα-παύομαι with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: [[r:ROM.15.32|Rom 15:32]] (L, om.).† (AS)
συν-αιχμάλωτος, -ου, ὁ a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): [[r:ROM.16.7|Rom 16:7]], [[r:COL.4.10|Col 4:10]], Phm 23.† (AS)
συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ (συνζητέω), a disputer, disputant: [[r:1CO.1.20|1Co 1:20.]]† (AS)
συμ-βουλεύω
to advise, counsel: with dative of person(s), [[r:JHN.18.14|Jhn 18:14]]; id. before inf., [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18.]]
Mid., to take counsel, consult: before ἵνα, [[r:MAT.26.4|Mat 26:4]] ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr., 157); with inf., [[r:ACT.9.23|Act 9:23.]]† (AS)

G4874.root: from [[w:G4862]] and a compound of [[w:G0303]] and [[w:G3396]]
G4874.strongs: to mix up together, i.e. (figurative) associate with
senses: συν-ανα-μίγνυμι (accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): [[r:1CO.5.9|1Co 5:9 5:11]], [[r:2TH.3.14|2Th 3:14]] (see M, Th., 117).† (AS)

G4859.strongs: sounding together (alike), i.e. (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement)
senses: (ούν, φωνή), agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, harmonious, agreeing: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5.]]† (AS)

G4829.strongs: to share jointly, i.e. participate in
senses: συν-μερίζω (Rec. συμμ-), to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: [[r:1CO.9.13|1Co 9:13]] (Diod., al.).† (AS)
συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ (συμφωνέω), concord, agreement: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[r:2CO.6.15|2Co 6:15.]]† (AS)
συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-) to send together with: with accusative and dative, [[r:2CO.8.22|2Co 8:22]]; id. before μετά, with genitive, [[r:2CO.8.18|2Co 8:18.]]† (AS)

G4813.root: from a derivative of σύλλω (to strip
G4813.strongs: probably akin to; compare); to despoil
senses: with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil: [[r:2CO.11.8|2Co 11:8.]]† (AS)

G4882.strongs: to despatch (on an errand) in company with
senses: συν-απο-στέλλω to send along with: with accusative, [[r:2CO.12.18|2Co 12:18]] (cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)
συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-, to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, [[r:EPH.2.5|Eph 2:5]]; σὺν τ. Χ., [[r:COL.2.13|Col 2:13.]]† (AS)

G4891.strongs: to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to
senses: συν-εγείρω to raise together: metaphorically, of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, [[r:EPH.2.6|Eph 2:6]]; pass., [[r:COL.2.12|Col 2:12 3:1]].† (AS)

G4847.strongs: a native of the same town, i.e. (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-Christian)
senses: συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, [[r:EPH.2.19|Eph 2:19]] (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).† (AS)

G4883.root: from [[w:G4862]] and a derivative of a compound of [[w:G0719]] and [[w:G3004]] (in its original sense of laying)
G4883.strongs: to render close-jointed together, i.e. organize compactly
senses: συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ (ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω, to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, [[r:EPH.2.21|Eph 2:21]]; of the members of the body, [[r:EPH.4.16|Eph 4:16]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον, partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), [[r:EPH.3.6|Eph 3:6]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:EPH.5.7|Eph 5:7]] (Arist.).† (AS)

G4866.strongs: to wrestle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to seek jointly
senses: συν-αθλέω, -ῶ = συναγωνίζομαι: with dative commod., [[r:PHP.1.27|Php 1:27]]; with dative of person(s), before ἐν, [[r:PHP.4.3|Php 4:3.]]† (AS)
σύν-ψυχος (Rec. συμ-), -ον (ψυχή), of one mind: [[r:PHP.2.2|Php 2:2.]]† (AS)

G4833.strongs: to render like, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate
senses: Pass. to be conformed to , τινι (New Testament) (ML)

G4831.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G4862]] and [[w:G3401]]
senses: συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ a fellow-imitator: with genitive obj., [[r:PHP.3.17|Php 3:17]] (see ICC, in l). Not elsewhere.† (AS)

G4805.strongs: co-yoked, i.e. (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; Syzygus, a Christian
senses: σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον (συνζεύγνυμι), a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, [[r:PHP.4.3|Php 4:3]] (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

G4812.root: from the base of [[w:G4813]] and (the reduplicated form of) [[w:G0071]]
G4812.strongs: to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce
senses: (σύλη, booty + ἄγω), to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8.]]† (AS)

G4853.strongs: a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country
senses: συμ-φυλέτης, -ου, ὁ (σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: [[r:ZEC.13.7|Zec 13:7]]; and see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.) a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: [[r:1TH.2.14|1Th 2:14]] (see M, Th., in l, and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.† (AS)

G4834.strongs: to feel "sympathy" with, i.e. (by implication) to commiserate
G4834.kjv: have compassion, be touched with a feeling of
senses: συν-παθέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: with dative of thing(s), [[r:HEB.4.15|Heb 4:15]]; dative of person(s), [[r:HEB.10.34|Heb 10:34]] (Arist., Plut., al.).† (AS)

G4881.strongs: to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with
senses: συν-απ-όλλυμι to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): with dative of person(s), [[r:HEB.11.31|Heb 11:31.]]† (AS)

G4887.strongs: to bind with, i.e. (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively)
senses: συν-δέω
to bind together;
to bind together with: pass., [[r:HEB.13.3|Heb 13:3.]]† (AS)

G4835.strongs: having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e. (by implication) mutually commiserative
senses: (σύν, πάσχω)
affected by like feelings, sympathetic: [[r:1PE.3.8|1Pe 3:8.]]
exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).† (AS)
συν-πρεσβύτερος (Rec. συμπ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-elder: [[r:1PE.5.1|1Pe 5:1]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

G4899.strongs: chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian)
senses: συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, see ICC, in l), [[r:1PE.5.13|1Pe 5:13.]]† (AS)
